description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractCryptoClient` within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for cryptographic operations related to encryption and decryption. It includes support for cipher validation, cipher name translation for OpenSSL, and interfaces for streaming encryption/decryption workflows.

classes.name: AbstractCryptoClient
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational cryptographic functions for AWS SDK, including cipher support verification, cipher name mapping, and interfaces for encryption/decryption stream factories. Deprecated in favor of newer workflows.

methods.name: isSupportedCipher
methods.description: Checks if a given cipher name is supported by the SDK.

methods.name: getCipherOpenSslName
methods.description: Abstract method to get OpenSSL cipher name from internal cipher name and key size.

methods.name: buildCipherMethod
methods.description: Abstract method to construct a CipherMethod object using cipher name, IV, and key size.

methods.name: getCipherFromAesName
methods.description: Abstract method to map AES name from metadata to OpenSSL cipher name.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Abstract method defining the interface to create an encryption stream with provided data and materials.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Abstract method defining the interface to create a decryption stream with provided cipher text and materials.
